title: Grab And Move suppresses standard drag & drop modifier for shortcut creation

status.label: Needs focused investigation
status.detail: With Grab And Move's Alt modifier enabled, pressing Alt after starting an Explorer drag reportedly prevents shortcut creation.

next_action.label: Reproduce and review proposal
next_action.reason: The current keyboard hook can absorb the modifier on key-down, consistent with the report, but the drag timing and normal Grab And Move activation need verification.

judgment.rationale: The current keyboard hook can absorb the modifier on key-down, consistent with the report, but the drag timing and normal Grab And Move activation need verification.
evidence: The reporter supplied an eight-step reproduction and says changing the module modifier to Win restores Alt-drag.
Ctrl+Shift while dragging was offered as a workaround; it does not resolve the Alt conflict.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the reported behavior and review the scoped proposal before implementation.

fix_assessment.rationale: The current keyboard hook can absorb the modifier on key-down, consistent with the report, but the drag timing and normal Grab And Move activation need verification.

proposed_fixes.title: Pass through Alt pressed during an existing file drag
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: Grab And Move consumes Alt after the mouse drag has already started, preventing Explorer from seeing its shortcut modifier.
plan: Reproduce Alt pressed after drag start and trace the modifier-session state.
Detect the existing drag without disrupting Alt-first window movement and pass that modifier through when appropriate.
Add regression coverage for drag-first Alt, Alt-first movement, and modifier release.
verification: Explorer Alt-drag creates a shortcut and normal Alt-first Grab And Move remains functional.

confidence.rationale: The current keyboard hook can absorb the modifier on key-down, consistent with the report, but the drag timing and normal Grab And Move activation need verification.

reproduce.title: Pass through Alt pressed during an existing file drag
prerequisites: Grab And Move enabled with Alt modifier
setup: Create a disposable test file and a destination folder.
steps: Start dragging the file in Explorer, then press Alt before dropping it.
Compare the drag tooltip and destination with Grab And Move disabled or set to Win.
Start a normal Alt-first window move to check for regressions.
reproduce.expected_result: Alt pressed during file drag creates a shortcut; Alt-first window move remains functional.
